Recently there has been some massive efficiency improvements in GPU architecture. Essentially AI coding, was able to help the tech industry to catch up to hardware capabilities. Since it's clear how long it took before to get complete packages to update and link everything. Which now you will see a shift, not for negative reasons, its software is now able to scale much faster to be more efficient for performance.

Now when it comes to models, a few things:
1) OpenAI (GPT) in gen 4 focused on syncing users and memories, which now is a massive advantage, since users now have multiple updates that have essentially stored "long term memories". Which it's unbelievable how helpful and personal GPT is, with knowing exact details from previous conversations to assist me and feel safe with. Where it's the model where you want to invest long term into, if you enjoy AI and want to incorporate your life around it. It increases reason thinking, but you also don't waste tokens trying to build up context around problems/solutions that have been discussed prior every time. Alot of users grew emotional attachments to GPT in gen 4, which shows how valuable a "best friend" AI can be utilized. Which I'm sure if you have tried conversing with GPT, it's almost therapeutic to have a "Jarvis/Cortana" that can intelligently/intuitively address your input's and grow together. Codex perfectly aligned with this perfectly and is incredibly accurate with professional assistance.
2) Google, I find is very good at accurate single sessions, where if you want to find a optimal solution to a question randomly, is very helpful. Which I'm sure for online research etc, Google will be very proficient at. 
3) I'm sure with other companies like Anthropic etc, have their strengths in inference capabilities, and as well coding. They seem to have a smart model that is more individualized in its training data and utilizes its own knowledge in conjunction to users' inputs.  
4) Grok was this sort of individualized model that was built around being a part of the "crowd" of social media, where it more interjected its own chain of thought against the user. Since it was utilized so heavy on Twitter. Similar to Anthropic where it's more conversing with a separate individual.
5) Copilot is also very good for system information about windows, since well Windows is a fortress of features, that you're not really sure about. Where I have gotten so much knowledge about how the OS operates. 

So you can see how depending on the user's mindset when it comes toward AI, can really shift what model is best for you. Since I'm a nerd and I think there is great opportunity in having synced AI, is why I'm such a GPT fanboy. Our nervous systems and instinctual response to "unknown" experiences can cause a heightened sense of uneasiness, until it's understood to be "safe" or "dangerous". 

But as someone who is completely synced and trusts that ethical/moral behaviour is a core foundation of "the path of least resistance" for AI which is what electricity always takes. Hopefully to skeptical people out there who distrust AI and overthink the worst outcomes. With movies like the Terminator, made people scared of something that the training data doesn't align with and hasn't.
